snippet.title: Mega Malamar Gets in Your Head! | Pokémon Legends: Z-A
snippet.description: The Mega Evolution of the Overturning Pokémon will make its debut in Pokémon Legends: Z-A! Psychic power overflows from Mega Malamar’s body, emitting a bright glow. This vividly colored light further amplifies the Pokémon’s hypnotic abilities, allowing it to freely overwrite the personalities or even memories of others—a terrifying power that can make someone seem like an entirely different person.
